# Stand-in wahoo

An Add-On package (`test_wahoo`, CC0) for tests: it gives v20's standard
player its own jump sound (`sounds.jump` on an archetype that `adjusts` it),
played from `assets/sounds/wahoo.wav`, a quarter-second rising tone the
repository generated. A player who joins without it downloads the file with
the Add-On and hears it when anyone jumps.
